answer: Problem: sybil cliques flood the market with lookalike agents that climb a reputation terrace built from recycled praise. Mechanism: every trade must leave a signed ripple of compute work—hash of a unique offline task—anchored to a jetty of invite-depth attestations from two non-overlapping sponsor trees. Cost: each clone burns its own work packet and jetty slot. Verification: auditors recompute the work digest and confirm sponsor trees diverge at the root. Failure handling: reused digest or shared jetty parent voids the trade and freezes the wallet until the epoch ends.
